An organic nitrile derivative P undergoes a sequence of reactions as shown below.
P = 4-(2-oxopropyl)benzonitrile
P --[Br₂, CH₃COOH]--> Q
Q --[Br₂, CH₃COOH]--> R
R --[SeO₂]--> S
S --[Tollens' reagent, then H₃O⁺]--> T
R --[Br₂, CH₃COOH]--> U
Which of the following statements is/are correct?
(A) Compound Q contains exactly one stereocentre.
(B) Compound R gives a positive iodoform test upon treatment with I₂ and aqueous NaOH.
(C) Compound S gives a positive Tollens' test.
(D) Compound T does not produce effervescence with aqueous NaHCO₃ solution.
Choose all the correct options.
